title: Read the last words of every piece out loud
text: Read the last words of every piece out loud. Each one is a finished sentence that lands, not just a pause: no "...คือ", "...ก็", "...แล้วกันพี่", no question left hanging. `hks_cut_check` finds pauses, not finished thoughts. A clean result there doesn't mean the endings are finished.
confirm: What are the last words of every piece, and does each land as a finished sentence?
probe: 4. **Read the last words of every piece out loud.**
